items.title: 操作前的样子
items.text: 每做一步，撤销历史就存一份「动手前」的快照。按撤销时恢复的是那份原样，不是重新生成。

items.title: 和重做是一对
items.text: 撤销退一步，重做（Ctrl+Shift+Z 或 Ctrl+Y）把退掉的那步再做回来。两者共用同一条历史。

items.title: 历史有限度
items.text: 通常只保留最近若干步，刷新或关闭页面就清空。依赖撤销兜底之前，要紧的操作还是先确认。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 撤销和「重新创建」不同：撤销恢复原来那条（连 ID 和时间都一样），重新创建是一条新记录。撤销和回滚（Rollback）也不同：回滚退的是整个版本（比如部署回到上一版），撤销退的是你的一步操作。

lessonPractice.title: 表格里删错了一条报价记录，下面哪个做法找回它最快、最不容易出错？

options.label: 立刻按 Ctrl+Z 撤销删除
options.feedback: 对。撤销把刚发生的一步原样退回，删掉的记录按原来的样子回来——比重打快，也不会引入新错误。

options.label: 凭记忆重新新建一条一样的
options.feedback: 重打是新建一条，金额和日期可能记错；撤销恢复的才是原来那条。

options.label: 刷新页面让删除失效
options.feedback: 刷新不会撤销操作，反而可能把撤销历史清掉——这一步做完就真的退不回了。

en.title: You deleted the wrong quote row. Which way recovers it fastest and most safely?

options.label: Press Ctrl+Z right away to undo the delete
options.feedback: Correct. Undo rolls back the last step exactly as it was—faster than retyping and free of new mistakes.

options.label: Recreate an identical record from memory
options.feedback: Retyping creates a new record and risks misremembering; undo restores the original one.

options.label: Refresh the page to cancel the delete
options.feedback: Refreshing does not undo anything and may wipe the undo history—after that there is no way back.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 给表格的删除操作加撤销：删错一条后按 Ctrl+Z 能原样恢复，不用重新填。删除本身仍然先弹确认。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add undo to the table's delete action: Ctrl+Z restores a wrongly deleted row exactly as it was. Keep the confirmation dialog before deleting as well.

references.title: 撤销、重做与历史记录
references.title_en: Undo, redo and the history stack

learning.assumes: You have pressed Ctrl+Z to undo typing in any editor.
learning.outcome: You know undo restores the original state rather than recreating it, and that it cannot reach back past a page refresh.

modules.title: Delete a row, then undo it back

items.title: The state before the action
items.text: Each step stores a "before" snapshot; pressing undo restores that original rather than regenerating it.

items.title: Paired with redo
items.text: Undo steps back, redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y) re-applies the undone step. Both share one history.

items.title: History is finite
items.text: Usually only recent steps survive, and refresh or close clears it. Critical actions still deserve confirmation first.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Undo is not "recreate": it restores the original record, ID and timestamps included, while recreating makes a new one. It also differs from rollback, which reverts a whole version such as a deployment. The same applies to working with AI—"undo this step" beats "make a new one" on both speed and safety.

distinctions.label: Rollback
distinctions.text: {c:rollback} reverts a whole version, like a deployment; {c:undo} reverts your single last action.

distinctions.label: Popconfirm
distinctions.text: {c:popconfirm} prevents a risky action before it happens; {c:undo} rescues it right after.
